The command should be intuitive, supporting both quick checks and detailed profiling.

### Syntax
```bash
llm-cli benchmark [OPTIONS]
```

### Key Options
| Option | Short | Description | Default |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `--preset` | `-p` | Selects a predefined benchmark preset (e.g., `stable`, `fast`, `heavy`). | `stable` |
| `--model` | `-m` | Path to the model file (required if not in config). | `~/.llm/config/model` |
| `--warmup` | `-w` | Number of warmup iterations before measurement. | `3` |
| `--repeat` | `-r` | Number of times
